What happens now

  1. We call you

    From (310) 564-7911, during business hours. A real person. If you miss it, we call again.

  2. Don't talk to the adjuster yet

    If they call before we do, take their name and number and say your lawyer will be in touch. Don't give a recorded statement.

  3. See a doctor if you haven't

    Urgent care or your own doctor. The gap between the crash and your first visit is the first thing the insurer looks for.
